items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is a full faithfulness statement for the completion functor on morphisms of algebraic spaces (source lines 6831-6943, label lemma-completion-functor-fully-faithful). The solver must run an etale-descent gluing argument whose overlap comparison rests on completion commuting with fibre products, then execute a two-stage reduction to the affine case and close it with the chapter's rig-etale algebraization lemma; none of these steps is a routine citation. Allowed background: the completion formalism of the chapter and the cited formal-spaces lemmas, which are delivered as navigation pointers.
